name: Jian Hao Lim
bio:
Jian Hao's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by attending the Singapore Grand Prix annually with his family. He pursued a degree in Marketing from the National University of Singapore, supplementing his studies with internships at local automotive publications. His career began at a small racing team, where he quickly demonstrated a knack for crafting engaging content and building online communities. 

At Herberth Motorsport, Jian Hao focuses on expanding the team's digital footprint and developing innovative marketing campaigns that resonate with both seasoned motorsport enthusiasts and new fans. He believes in a data-driven approach, constantly analyzing campaign performance and adapting strategies to maximize impact. Jian Hao's distinctive ability to blend technical understanding with creative storytelling makes him a valuable asset to the team.

Jian Hao is deeply committed to bringing a new level of excitement and accessibility to Herberth Motorsport's brand. He is always looking to improve his skills, and finds that watching old races, and trying to understand the decisions behind marketing done for those races, help him improve his work.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Jian Hao is of average height with a lean build, and an energetic presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas, even in the middle of meetings.
Has a collection of miniature race cars on his desk, each representing a significant race in Herberth Motorsport's history.
Frequently uses motorsport analogies in everyday conversations.
